name: 73055 · Marlow, OK
findings: ZIP 73055 (Marlow) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (21%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 73055 (Marlow) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
